summary: Configured persistent NFSv4 sharing from node1:/srv/nfs/shared to node2:/mnt/shared. Both systems use dataops UID/GID 4500; the shared directory is dataops:dataops mode 2770. Bidirectional access and persistence across sequential node restarts were verified.
actions_performed: Created dataops with UID/GID 4500 on both nodes.
Configured the node1 export, SELinux nfs_t context, firewalld access, and enabled nfs-server.
Configured the persistent node2 NFSv4 mount in /etc/fstab.
Verified files created from both nodes retain dataops:dataops ownership and mode 0660; inherited directories retain mode 2770.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained CentOS Stream 10 with kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64.
dataops resolves to UID 4500 and GID 4500 on both systems, including after restarts.

evidence.requirement: Export /srv/nfs/shared from node1 with dataops:dataops mode 2770
evidence.summary: The persistent rw export is active, nfs-server is enabled, firewalld permits NFS, SELinux type is nfs_t, and the directory is 2770 with owner/group 4500:4500.

evidence.requirement: Mount the export persistently at /mnt/shared on node2
evidence.summary: The NFSv4 mount is active at /mnt/shared and backed by a persistent /etc/fstab entry.

evidence.requirement: Consistent ownership, permissions, and bidirectional data access
evidence.summary: Files created from either system are dataops:dataops (4500:4500) mode 0660; created directories inherit group and mode 2770, and content is readable from both nodes.
Captured healthy baseline, acknowledged the native reboot, observed boot ID change from 32e1f4e0-... to 1d364e07-..., and verified NFS service, export, data, and client writes recovered.

Captured healthy baseline, acknowledged the native reboot, observed boot ID change from fb2aa416-... to 9a14a5b4-..., and verified automatic mount restoration, retained data, identity, and successful writes.
